question: What's the difference between the Biology major and the Biochemistry major in terms of required courses? Which one has more chem?

body.answer:
Biochemistry BS requires all of these chemistry courses: CHEM 117 and 117L; CHEM 211 and 211L; CHEM 213 and 213L; CHEM 324 and 324L; CHEM 350 and 350L; CHEM 425; CHEM 430; and CHEM 446. [1]

Biology BS requires CHEM 117 and 117L, plus one organic chemistry option: either CHEM 206 and 206L, or CHEM 211 and 211L plus CHEM 213 and 213L. It also requires four electives; at least one must be from the biology elective options with a lab or field component and at least one from the options without lab or field components. CHEM 425 is one option in the latter list, but it is not mandatory. [2]

So Biochemistry has more required chemistry: it requires additional chemistry courses, while Biology offers a shorter organic chemistry option and makes CHEM 425 optional. [1][2]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BS-BCHM) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BS-BIOL)

question: should i major in chemistry or biology if i want to get into pharmacy school

body.answer:
If you’re aiming for Ramapo’s Pharmacy Early Acceptance Program with LECOM, Biology is the clearest fit: the program awards a Ramapo B.S. in Biology, and Ramapo lists a “Biology/Touro Pharm 3+4” track. [1][3] The pages don’t say that Biology is required for pharmacy school generally or that Chemistry is a bad choice; they don’t give a general recommendation between the two. [1][2][3]

For LECOM’s Pharmacy EAP, the pages say to apply separately from your Ramapo application (high school seniors may apply); complete LECOM’s online EAP application by April 1; and, if eligible, self-schedule an offered interview. A successful interview may lead to provisional acceptance. You need that provisional acceptance before starting your second undergraduate year. Phase II requires an overall GPA of 3.2 or higher and a science GPA of 3.0. To enter LECOM, submit a PharmCas application, complete three years of undergraduate study, and meet GPA and other requirements. The PCAT is encouraged, not required. The program is three years at Ramapo plus four years of pharmacy education. [3][6]

The Pharmacy EAP is handled by LECOM. Ramapo Admissions lists admissions@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7300. [3][6] For help choosing, the Center for Student Success recommends gathering information, talking with advisors and faculty, and meeting with your major’s convener when ready; contact success@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7441. [8] The Pre-Medical/Pre-Health Club welcomes aspiring pharmacists; email premed@ramapo.edu. [7]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BS-BIOL) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SN-BS-CHEM) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/undergraduate/freshmen/admission-requirements/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/undergraduate/freshmen/admission-requirements/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/pre-medicalpre-health-organization/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/major/)

value.section_words: Ramapo College’s curriculum. In evaluating a student’s transcript, only the academic credits transfer; the grades do not transfer. A student’s grade point average at Ramapo will reflect only credits earned at Ramapo College. International students must submit an evaluation of coursework by a recognized evaluation service that is approved by the National Association of Credit Evaluation Services (NACES). Based on that evaluation, credit is awarded on a course-by-course basis. Although accepted transfer credits count toward the 128 required for graduation, the specific applicability of these credits toward course requirements must be approved through the transfer evaluation and advisement process. question: Could you tell me what the Business Administration major requires in terms of core courses and total credits?

body.answer:
The catalog entry provided is for the Business Administration MBA (Master of Business Administration), not a bachelor’s major. Its requirements list these core courses: MBAD 601 ACCOUNTING FOR MANAGERIAL DECISION MAKING; MBAD 610 BECOMING A 21ST CENTURY LEADER; MBAD 620 FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT I; MBAD 638 INFO TECH FOR MANAGERS; MBAD 640 MARKETING MANAGEMENT & STRATEGY; MBAD 660 OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT; MBAD 675 MBA IFK ASSESSMENT; MBAD 680 MANAGING RESPONSIBLE GLOBAL BUSINESS. [1]

The MBA requirements also list all of these foundational courses: ACCT 510 FOUNDATIONS OF ACCOUNTING; BADM 510 FOUNDATION STATS FOR BUSINESS; ECON 510 FOUNDATIONS OF ECONOMICS; FINC 510 FOUNDATIONS OF FINANCE; MGMT 510 FOUNDATIONS OF MANAGEMENT; MKTG 510 FOUNDATIONS OF MARKETING. Students in the 30-credit Advanced Standing Program do not need to complete this requirement. [1]

Electives: select 3 courses (9 credits), at least 3 of: ACCT 604 FINANCIAL STATEMENT ANALYSIS; ACCT 605 ADVANCED AUDITING AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SYSTEMS; ACCT 610 FORENSIC ACCOUNTING; ACCT 615 ADVANCED FEDERAL TAXATION ISSUES; ACCT 625 INTERNATIONAL ACCOUNTING; DATA 601 INTRODUCTION TO DATA SCIENCE; MBAD 612 LEADING CHANGE IN AN UNCERTAIN WORLD; MBAD 613 LEADERSHIP LAB; MBAD 615 BUSINESS ANALYTICS; MBAD 621 MANAGING CORPORATE VALUE; MBAD 624 SECURITIES ANALYSIS AND PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT; MBAD 630 LEADING SUSTAINABLE BUSINESS; MBAD 636 ENTREPRENEURSHIP; MBAD 639 ANALYTIC TOOLS FOR MANAGERS; MBAD 641 NEGOTIATIONS; MBAD 642 DIGITAL MARKETING; MBAD 644 MARKETING ANALYTICS; MBAD 646 SERVICE OPERATION&MANAGEMENT; MBAD 650 AI FOR BUSINESS LEADERS; MBAD 652 AI AND ETHICS; MBAD 662 SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT; MBAD 664 PROJECT MANAGEMENT; MBAD 668 BLOCKCHAIN FOR SUPPLY CHAIN; MBAD 670 DATA VISUALIZATION; MBAD 682 GLOBAL IMMERSION EXPERIENCE:CHINA. The listed requirements total 42.1 credits, based on the catalog course-credit sum. [1]

question: What does CMPS 147 cover, and is there a prerequisite I need before enrolling in it?

body.answer:
CMPS 147 COMPUTER SCIENCE I is 4 credits. It introduces problem-solving with computers, including basic computer-system concepts; ANSI C++ programming; algorithm design; program development, debugging, testing and documentation; and variables, data types, expressions, selection, repetition, functions and arrays. A course fee is required. It carries the Gen Ed 18-Quantitative Rsng (GEQR) attribute. [1]

Before registering, satisfactorily complete one of these courses: MATH 021 PREPARATION FOR COLLEGE MATHEMATICS PROGRAM; MATH 022 TRANSITIONAL MATHEMATICS; MATH 024 ELEMENTARY ALGEBRA TOPICS; MATH 100T TRANSFER GE MATH EQUIVALENT; MATH 101 MATH WITH APPLICATIONS; MATH 104 MATH FOR THE MODERN WORLD; MATH 108 ELEMENTARY PROBABILITY AND STATISTICS; MATH 110 PRECALCULUS; or MATH 121 CALCULUS I. Alternatively, complete one placement test with the minimum score: ACCUPLACER Quantitative Reasoning 258; ACCUPLACER Advanced Algebra and Functions 260; ACT Composite 26; or SAT MATH 580. [1]

The Registrar says to review prerequisite requirements in Web Self Service and course descriptions there. Transfer or visiting students who fulfilled the prerequisite but cannot register should contact the academic school offering the course. If you prove you satisfied it, the unit secretary may place an override on your record; then complete registration in Experience: https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/. [3] Contact the Registrar at reg@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7695. [3]

question: I am interested in nursing but I can only attend part time. What is the recommended sequence of courses for someone starting the nursing program?

body.answer:
The Nursing Generic BSN is the track for students interested in becoming nurses; its recommended plan is for students admitted in 2026–2027. It is not identified as a part-time plan. The Accelerated BSN is explicitly a full-time, daytime, in-person program [1,2].

Recommended Nursing Generic BSN sequence [2]:
• First year, Fall (17 credits): INTD 101, CHEM 111/111L, CRWT 102, General Education, PATH 001.
• First year, Spring (16): General Education ×2, PSYC 101, MATH 108.
• Second year, Fall: General Education ×2, BIOL 214/214L, free elective, PATH 002.
• Second year, Spring (15): General Education, BIOL 216/216L, BIOL 212/212L, PATH 003.
• Third year, Fall (16): NURS 305, 306, 325, 330.
• Third year, Spring (16): NURS 340, 345, 355, 370.
• Fourth year, Fall (16): NURS 410, 425, 430, 435.
• Fourth year, Spring (16): NURS 440, 475, 450, 470.
Total required: 128 credits. The plan lists another track for that year, Nursing/RN/BSN [2]. Nursing Generic BSN also publishes Nursing MSN [2].

The plan does not say how to follow this sequence part time. Contact the Nursing Programs Office: (201) 684-7749, Adler Center for Nursing Excellence 215.

question: Does Ramapo have any certificate programs that a working adult could finish without completing a full bachelor's degree?

body.answer:
Ramapo’s catalog lists seven certificates: Applied Ethics; Business Essentials; Business Foundations-Graduate; Data Analyst-Graduate; Data Modeler-Graduate; Machine Learning Engineer-Graduate; and Spanish for Health Care and Human Services Professionals. [3] Graduate certificates require at least 9 credits beyond the bachelor’s level. [4] Business Essentials is specifically identified as a Graduate Certificate, so it does not appear to be an option to finish without a bachelor’s degree. [1][4] The catalog does not specify the level for Applied Ethics or Spanish for Health Care and Human Services Professionals, so I can’t verify whether those can be completed without a bachelor’s degree. [3][4]

Ramapo welcomes non-degree/visiting students who are interested in an academic certificate, but that page lists Business Essentials, Graduate Certificate in Business Foundations, Middle School Teacher, Spanish for Healthcare and Human Services Professionals, and Investigative Genetic Genealogy; its list differs from the catalog’s. It does not say that taking non-degree courses lets you complete a certificate without a bachelor’s degree. [9][3]

question: Which gen ed categories can be satisfied by a single course, and is there a limit on how many gen ed courses can also count toward my major?

body.answer:
A single course may not fulfill two separate General Education competencies [2]. You take one course in each keystone category—Global Awareness, Historical Perspectives, Scientific Reasoning, and Quantitative Reasoning—and one course in two of the three distribution categories [7]. For Fall 2026, the distribution categories are Culture and Creativity, Values and Ethics, and Social Systems and Society [5]. The College’s catalog also lists the keystone and distribution requirements [8].

No more than two General Education courses may count both toward General Education and your major [2].

Sources: [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#integrity-of-degree-programs1) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/provost/home/comprehensive-academic-plan/resources/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/provost/curriculum-and-assessment/) [8](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#general-education)

question: What are the prereqs for PSYC 201 Research Methods, and does it count toward the psych major or only as an elective?

body.answer:
The catalog lists Research Methods in Psychology as PSYC 303, not PSYC 201. [2] PSYC 303 requires all of: CRWT 102 or CRWT 102S; PSYC 101; and PSYC 242 or BADM 225. [2]

PSYC 303 is a required course in the Psychology BA major, not merely an elective. [1] It is 4 credits. [2]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SO-BA-PSYC) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/PSYC303)

question: Given my schedule, should I major in information technology or in business? Which one would be easier to finish while working?

body.answer:
I can’t recommend one based on your schedule: the pages don’t assess your personal schedule or say which major fits you better. The catalog lists Information Technology Management BS; “business” needs to be narrowed to a specific major, such as Accounting BS, Finance BS, International Business BA, Management BS, or Marketing BS. [1][2] IT Management combines IT and business coursework. Its recommended 2026–2027 plan is for students admitted to the major that academic year: eight semesters, with 16, 16, 16, 18, 16, 16, 16, and 16 credits listed, and 128 total credits required. [1] The pages don’t compare how quickly or easily it—or a business major—can be completed while working. [1][4]

For help deciding, the Center for Student Success (Academic Advising) recommends reading the catalog, asking questions, talking with advisors and students, considering classes that help you choose, and talking with faculty in the majors. [4] Contact the Center for Student Success at success@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7441, room D-207. [4]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SB-BS-INFM) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/studentsuccess/major/)
